method: common-word dual POS/agreement/valency grammars intersected during decoding with a live character residual, lexical distinctness, and an online complementary-boundary mask

novelty_preflight.difference_from_prior_runs: grammar, exact character equality, and shortcut rejection are simultaneous state constraints rather than post-hoc scoring or repair

grammar.valency: finite verbs require a WordNet transitive frame and every transitive template realizes its object

diagnostic_without_boundary_mask.interpretation: the unmasked closure is exactly the complementary token-boundary shortcut that the online mask must reject

incumbent_specific_obstruction.statement: the finite single-clause product exhausts all 484 template pairs without closure; its deepest surviving residual is olc at a DET-DET cursor, so merely enlarging the same flat templates is not a new method
